comment_regular: XRGD singleton loader: count=(size/28)&0xFF, then size % count is tested instead of %28. count==0 faults (including 0..27 and canonical 256-bone size); nonzero remainder cleanly fails and the caller removes the singleton; remainder zero with size!=count*28 is accepted, allocates count*28, then reads size and overflows. Safe success is 1..255 complete 28-byte bones. Successful repeats replace count/buffer and leak the prior buffer.
